_comment: Tools/Blender/hs_build_ship.py: the Wayfarer's exterior straight from the approved drawing (Design/Wayfarer_layout.json, exterior). Every part matches the drawing by construction (loft / intersection of the outlines, or revolved to the drawing's radii); on top: real panel grooves, a canopy frame, revolved pods with intake and nozzle (Tools/Blender/hs_build_part.py), cylindrical guns. Materials by part, no AI texture.

kit_modules._comment: Rooms from the interior kit (ArtSource/Kit, kit brief step 7.1, 28. 9. 2026): hs_interior builds only their bulkheads and the stand-ins; Tools/Assets/kit_rooms.py puts the kit parts into BP_Ship_<Ship> as components (InteriorMod_*, lights Light_fix_kit_*). Layout (design) metres: x forward, y to port, z from the deck; wall runs (start, end, face normal, modules), run parts (start, direction, parts one after another), as import_kit.SHOWROOM but in design axes.
kit_modules._enabled: On since 29. 9. 2026 (the author: switch the kit corridor on, so walking the ship shows the kit parts that the cabin and the hold will be built from). Before: The author's switch (28. 9. 2026): off until batch 4 is done (the component bays are built, 28. 9. evening; the doors, bulkheads and hull liner are not). Earlier: off until batch 4 brings the component bays - the procedural corridor (interior.kit) shows its reactor and coolers, the kit's grilles do not. true: hs_interior leaves the room to the kit (kit_rooms.py); rebuild the ship and import it.
kit_modules._tech: Technical corridor 8.24-10.34 (bulkhead faces): the aft portal frames the door from the hold, 1.8 m of walls - reactor behind the grille and the left cooler to port, the shield generator's hatch and the right cooler to starboard (layout objects). No W floor plate of 0.3 m yet: a stand-in strip under the portal.
kit_modules._tech_batch4: Batch 4 (28. 9. 2026): the component bays where the layout has the components - the power plant (Wall_ComponentBay12W_A) and the left cooler (06W_B) to port, the shield generator (12W_C) and the right cooler (06W_B) to starboard.
kit_modules._tech_bulkheads: 29. 9. 2026 (author walked the ship: the corridor ends were the bulkheads' flat faces): the aft portal became Bulkhead_Door03W_B - a 0.3 m bulkhead with the doorway 0.5 m to port through it (the hold's door), pivot at its starboard corner on the face plane (x 8.54); forward the thin face Bulkhead_Door00W_A 1 cm in front of the procedural bulkhead (10.34, the cabin is not a kit room yet), its door centred - the layout door moved from y 0.1 to 0.0.
kit_modules._tech_r1: Critic round 1: cable trays along the whole ceiling (no flat panel), the grating over the service channel in front of the coolers.
kit_modules._hold_bulkhead: The hold's face of the bulkhead to the corridor: Bulkhead_Door00L41_C, 1 cm in front of the procedural bulkhead (8.2), the door 0.5 m to port seen from the hold (variant C: to its right).
kit_modules._hold: 29. 9. 2026 (author walked the ship: fix the walls, floor, ceiling): the hold from the kit's hull liner (Wall_HullLiner, section L, approved 28. 9.: a thin liner along the hull, 4.10 m at container height), liner face to face 4.1 m; the cargo side (starboard) with tie-down rails, the aisle side plain and service modules; ceiling panels L41 with a down-light and a linear light by turns from x 1.6 (over the ramp's first 0.6 m the hull closes in: the ramp frame's header beam, hs_interior). The floor, the cargo grid, the hatches and the ramp's hydraulics and the tractor beam holder stay the ship's own until the kit has a cargo floor (the grid's position waits for the author). Critic round 1: a down-light first at the ramp (the linear light there burnt a hotspot on the ramp's header), a vent panel at the bulkhead, the starboard's cargo and service modules by turns.
light_scale: _the kit lights in a room at their own level: [x0, x1, factor, room] in layout metres; the cabin (30. 9. 2026) under the hold's light plan came out at p50 0.28 (SC 0.08-0.18) - a smaller room, lighter floor
kit_modules._cabin: 30. 9. 2026 (author chose variant B of Docs/Kit/cabin_plan_wayfarer.png): the cabin from the hull liner, 3.8 m between the liner faces as the approved layout. Walls 10.39-15.19: 3 x 1.2 m and 2 x 0.6 m, port A-B-A-A (the service module ahead of the bunk), starboard A (the locker, the hygiene cell and the food dispenser stand in front of it); the last 0.6 m is 06L_D on both sides, a flush plinth (by the cockpit bulkhead the hull is 4.5 cm behind the liner face at floor level, the recessed plinth reaches 11 cm back). Bulkhead faces Bulkhead_Door00L38_A (aft, face at 10.40, 2 cm in front of the procedural bulkhead) and _F (forward, the doorway open to the ceiling over the cockpit stairs, face at 15.19); ceiling L38 A-C-A-C. The furniture from the kit (30. 9. 2026, kit_furniture.py): the berth on the port wall (its head aft), the suit locker, the hygiene cell (centred on its door at 12.4) and the galley unit on the starboard wall, each on the floor under its back edge 0.1 m off the liner's face. The floor from the kit (30. 9. 2026, author: the ship's large smooth tiles "a bathroom", not the corridor's kit floor): Floor_Plate12L38_A 10.39-15.19, the 5 cm under the aft bulkhead's face a stand-in.
